description: What the platform remembers about THIS person between conversations: up to six stable traits (role, industry, where they ship to, language, attitude to price, document requirements) and the one-line outcome of their last 5 conversations. Call it before you answer, so you do not ask again what they already told you. The person is taken from the visitor token — never pass an id. A guest gets an empty answer (`reason: "guest"`): we keep no memory without a cabinet where the person could see it. Nothing is carried over when a guest signs in — there was nothing to carry — but the account may already hold memory from earlier visits, so call this door again right after sign-in. Each trait carries `origin`: `human` means they said it outright, `model` means an agent inferred it — treat an inferred trait as a guess worth confirming, not as a fact. If this door is silent, answer as before.
name: get_person_memory
title: What we remember about the person
